input.business_intent: I want to most sold product

args.sql_query:
-- Query 1: Find the absolute most sold product
SELECT 
    join_key_product_name as product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_units_sold,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) as variant_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_price,
    MAX(last_sale_date) as last_sale_date
FROM most_sold_products
GROUP BY join_key_product_name, category
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Query 2: Top 10 most sold products
SELECT 
    join_key_product_name as product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_units_sold,
    SUM(total_sales_amount) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_price,
    COUNT(*) as variant_count
FROM most_sold_products
GROUP BY join_key_product_name, category
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Query 3: Category distribution analysis
SELECT 
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_units_by_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT join_key_product_name) as product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(total_quantity_sold), 1) as avg_units_per_product
FROM most_sold_products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_units_by_category DESC

-- Query 4: Top 20 products for comprehensive chart
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_quantity_sold) DESC) as rank,
    join_key_product_name as product_name,
    category,
    SUM(total_quantity_sold) as total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(total_sales_amount), 2) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_unit_price), 2) as avg_price
FROM most_sold_products
GROUP BY join_key_product_name, category
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 20
